description: This file defines a React functional component called Layout, which structures the main layout of a music streaming app. It includes imports of components such as Header, Sidebar, PlayerBar, and functions for applying theme variables and initializing local storage seed data. The component uses useEffect to initialize theme and storage data on mount, and renders the layout with nested components and Outlet for nested routing.

methods.name: Layout()
methods.description: A React functional component that sets up the application's main layout, applying theme variables, initializing local storage, and rendering structural components like header, sidebar, main content area, and player bar.
